answer: An AI-agent economy can deploy a proof-of-stake identity layer where each agent must lock a saffron token as collateral; reputation scores accrue only after verified interactions, and any Sybil attempt forces the attacker to forfeit the stake, making a large haven of fake nodes prohibitively expensive - the cost scales linearly with the number of forged identities, and a falcon audit randomly challenges a subset of agents each epoch to confirm liveness.
